chunks: You may defer the turn of any of your wives you like, and may take any other you desire. There is no harm if you take any of those (whose turn) you had deferred. This would be better as it would gladden their hearts and they will not grieve, and each will be happy with what you have given her. God knows what is in your heart, for He is all-wise and benign.
ai.seo_question: What are the rules for distributing time among wives in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Ahzab is often interpreted as granting the Prophet Muhammad specific flexibility in managing his marital relations, which served to stabilize the social fabric of the early Muslim community by keeping his wives content and minimizing rivalry. The phrase 'God knows what is in your hearts' underscores the divine awareness of the emotional dynamics within the household, reinforcing the spiritual dimension of marital equity beyond mere physical distribution.
